parts.text: A student adds excess large pieces of magnesium carbonate, MgCO 3 , to dilute hydrochloric acid, HC l , and measures the volume of carbon dioxide gas, CO 2 , given off.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Add the missing state symbols to the chemical equation for the reaction. MgCO 3 ..... + 2HC l ..... → MgC l 2 (aq) + H 2 O ..... + CO 2 ..... [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Complete the dot-and-cross diagram to show the electron arrangement of the ions in magnesium chloride. The inner shells have been drawn. Give the charges on the ions. [3]

ms.label: 2(b)
ms.text:
eight crosses in second shell of Mg
7 dots and 1 cross in third shell of both Cl
2+ charge on Mg and – charge on both Cl ions on correct answer line

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Complete the dot-and-cross diagram to show the electron arrangement in a molecule of carbon dioxide. Show outer shell electrons only. [2]

ms.label: 2(c)
ms.text:
C atom double bonded to 2 O atoms
4 non-bonding e on each O and no non-bonding e on C and both octets complete
-
–

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) The graph shows how the volume of carbon dioxide gas changes with time.

ms.label: 2(d)(ii)
ms.text:
concentration of particles (of acid) decreases
lower rate of collisions of particles

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) The student repeats the experiment using powdered MgCO 3 instead of large pieces. All other conditions stay the same. On the grid , draw the line expected when powdered MgCO 3 is used instead of large pieces. [2]

ms.label: 2(d)(iii)
ms.text:
a new line steeper than printed line and starts at origin and levels off earlier than printed line
levels off at the same volume

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Determine the volume of CO 2 gas given off when excess MgCO 3 is added to 25.0 cm 3 of 0.400 mol / dm 3 HC l at room temperature and pressure. MgCO 3 + 2HC l → MgC l 2 + H 2 O + CO 2 Use the following steps. ● Calculate the number of moles of HC l in 25.0 cm 3 of 0.400 mol / dm 3 of acid. .............................. mol ● Determine the number of moles of CO 2 gas given off. .............................. mol ● Calculate the volume of CO 2 gas given off in cm 3 . .............................. cm 3 [3]
